snippet.title: Streets of Rage 4 - Behind the Tracks
snippet.description:
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/985890/Streets_of_Rage_4/  
PS4 USA: https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP1482-CUSA16237_00-00STREETSOFRAGE4
Nintendo eShop: https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/streets-of-rage-4-switch/ 
PS4 EU: https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/product/EP1470-CUSA16221_00-00STREETSOFRAGE4
GOG: https://www.gog.com/game/streets_of_rage_4
Humble Bundle: https://fr.humblebundle.com/store/streets-of-rage-4
Xbox One: https://www.microsoft.com/en-gb/p/streets-of-rage-4/9n7h54kncb9n?activetab=pivot:overviewtab

The wait is over! Streets of Rage 4 is now available on PC, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4, Xbox One for $24,99!

Dotemu, Lizardcube and Guard Crush Games are thrilled to reveal that Yūzō Koshiro and Motohiro Kawashima, the original Streets of Rage series’ incomparable composers, will be joined by an all-star ensemble in contributing brand new tracks for the Streets of Rage 4 soundtrack.

Thanks to the help of Brave Wave Productions, a music label that brings the work of Japanese game musicians to global audiences, Streets of Rage 4 will feature original music from:

- Yūzō Koshiro (Streets of Rage 1, 2 & 3, Sonic the Hedgehog, The Revenge Shinobi, Shenmue I & II,...)
- Motohiro Kawashima (Streets of Rage 2 & 3, Shinobi II, Batman Returns,...)
- Yoko Shimomura (Street Fighter II: The World Warrior, Kingdom Hearts I, II & III, Legend of Mana, Parasite Eve,...) 
- Hideki Naganuma (Jet Set Radio & Future, Super Monkey Ball, Sega Rally 2,...)
- Keiji Yamagishi (Ninja Gaiden, Tecmo Bowl,...)

More information and surprises about the Streets of Rage 4 soundtrack will be revealed in the future. 

To keep your skull-cracking combo on the latest Streets of Rage 4 news going, head over to www.streets4rage.com, visit www.facebook.com/StreetsofRage4, and give the follow button a devastating high kick on Twitter @Dotemu, @Lizardcube and @Guard_Crush.

Special thanks to Archipel, Brave Wave and all the artists.
